sections.heading: What this case is about
paragraphs: Holland seeks equitable tolling of the AEDPA deadline. He claims his attorney failed to notify him of a mandate. This failure caused him to miss the filing window. Florida opposes this extension. The state argues only intentional misconduct qualifies. The Court must define the standard for tolling.

sections.heading: Why it matters
paragraphs: This case defines when attorney error excuses a missed deadline. It sets the standard for equitable tolling in federal habeas cases. The outcome affects how courts treat lawyer negligence. It determines whether clients can recover from attorney mistakes.
